lines.text: You're here because you've built meaningful experience, but you're ready for more.
More impact, more recognition, or simply a role that fits you better.
This track is part of your broader career journey.
Think of it as the mid-career checkpoint in your career map: a place where you pause, reassess, and deliberately choose what comes next instead of drifting.
As you move through the course, you'll see your progress bar update, so you always know exactly where you are and what's ahead.
You'll use simple tools in this platform: click-through activities, short reflections, uploads, and a few AI-powered prompts that help you analyze your own career story.
And you're not doing this alone — if you ever get stuck, you can reach out through the hashtag questionsupport channel or our member support team.
You may be juggling family responsibilities, leadership expectations, and a full calendar.
You might be wondering: Should I push for promotion?
Redesign my role to fit better?
Rather than trying to solve everything at once, this track helps you focus on your next, realistic move over the next six to twelve months.
We'll help you define that move, reposition your experience, and build momentum through small consistent steps.
Before we dive in, I want you to set a simple, powerful commitment: "Over the next 90 days, my main career goal is ___."
You'll write and submit that statement in a short activity.
It becomes your anchor for the rest of the track.
When you're ready, click Next to begin.
